result.brief: 系统诊断LLM智能体的世界模型预测式安全护栏，揭示预测到行动的鸿沟：更强预测参与并不单调提升安全性，长时程预测可靠性下降，且预测内容未被忠实利用。
result.reason: Diagnoses world-model predictive safety guardrails for LLM agents, evaluating prediction reliability and use; it is an analysis of world-model utility, not a new model or representation contribution.
